description: Traffic infringements issued is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. Count of all charge offences and infringement notices issued in Queensland from 1 July 2013 to 1 Oct 2025 by QPS Region and District, offence type, code and description. Coverage: Transport and Main Roads. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are breach, count, financial year, infringement, penalty. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-11-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
